text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Name's Hishi Amazon. Lookin' forward to workin' with ya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I race so I can clash with strong opponents
in a heated one-on-one showdown!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what kind of strong rivals we'll meet.
Big Sis Hishi Ama will take 'em all on with everything she's got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
